list: The official 55 trophies, names / descriptions / grades as PlayStation publishes them (Exophase, cross-checked with PSNProfiles and TrueAchievements, 18 Nov 2026). Guides are this tracker's own words, built from the official descriptions plus PowerPyx's trophy guide and roadmap.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — trophy list and PSN counts

trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and the platinum pops. Nothing here is online and no DLC is needed; the long pole is A Long Road (100% completion). PowerPyx rates the whole platinum 4/10 difficulty at roughly 200 hours. Work the roadmap in order — story first, then the 100% checklist, then cleanup — and this pops with your last trophy.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Story trophy: it pops when you finish Gone Fishing, the opening mission. You cannot miss it — just play the story and it comes to you.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 1. Automatic. Keep a manual save at the end of each chapter anyway — there is no mission replay, so chapter saves are your only safety net.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 2. Automatic — it pops as the chapter closes.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 3. Automatic — it pops as the chapter closes.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 4. Automatic — it pops as the chapter closes.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Story trophy for the final mission. Automatic once you finish the story — and after the credits you return to free-roam, so nothing is cut off. The real work starts now: the 100% checklist unlocks under Progress > Stats.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Story trophy for the Breakfast Run mission. Automatic — just play the mission when it comes up.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Story trophy for The Cartel Heist mission. Automatic — just play the mission when it comes up.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Story trophy for the Child's Play mission. Automatic — just play the mission when it comes up.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Story trophy for the Headliners mission. Automatic — just play the mission when it comes up.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Story trophy for the VCIA Takedown mission. Automatic — just play the mission when it comes up.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Story trophy for the Operation Savage Glory mission. Automatic — just play the mission when it comes up.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Attain 100% Completion: after the story, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and work the checklist. PowerPyx stresses it is closer to 60% true completion — you need 70 of 80 challenges, 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals and 50 of 66 weapons — but every robbery, underwater discovery, shooting range, drone race and Bret quest is required, plus 300 stunts. Use the in-game checklist as your map; this is the longest grind in the game and the hardest trophy.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts — jumps, under-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps. There are 397 stunts in the game and the 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past 250. PSN tracks your count, and stunt opportunities are everywhere once you start looking for ramps and gaps.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting range, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt. Sample one of each early — most pop naturally while you play the story, and each one opens up a deeper trophy of its own.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges — PSN tracks 42. Gold medals here are also required for 100% completion, so practise the ranges as you unlock them instead of leaving all 42 to the end. PowerPyx notes the gold medals are not too difficult.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations — PSN tracks 14. The 100% checklist wants all 42 drone time trials, so the races are worth learning properly rather than brute-forcing; a win at each location is the trophy, the time trials are the checklist.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any race type counts, but repeat wins on the same race do not — work through the race list and tick off new ones. Racing is also one of the 9 activity types for Master of None.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge: take the fishing challenge against Cal and out-fish him. Fishing is one of the 9 activity types, so this also feeds Master of None. No published guide has pinned the exact spot or the winning catch yet — check PowerPyx's trophy guide as players map the fishing spots.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game: find an arcade cabinet, pick a game and play it through to the end. Arcades are also one of the 9 activity types for Master of None, so this is an easy early tick.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy's strand is Lucia-only, so play it as Lucia and follow the strand to its last mission. Character strands are easy to leave behind during the story — check in with Andy whenever his icon is up.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Follow Kenton's strand to its end; like the other character strands, it is there to be finished when his missions appear, and every quest giver tied to a trophy returns after the story.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Follow Billy's strand to its end; do the missions as they appear rather than saving every strand for after the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. Stranger missions appear as you explore; finish 8 full strands. This is usually a cleanup-phase trophy — the 100% checklist does not ask for these quests — and every quest giver tied to a trophy comes back after the ending, so none of them can be missed.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Follow Randy's strand to its end; do the missions as they appear rather than saving every strand for after the story.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone's strand is Jason-only, so play it as Jason and follow the strand to its last mission.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every one of the 18 spots across Leonida. THIS IS THE MISSABLE ONE: PowerPyx flags it as the only potentially missable trophy — one meditation is offered at Jason's house in Chapter 1 (Lucia's balcony meditation after Down to Earth; check the kitchen in the morning and follow Lucia to the balcony) and may be lost after Chapter 1. Do it the moment it is offered and keep a separate Chapter 1 save as insurance. The last meditation cannot be done until you play as both characters, after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. The 100% checklist only needs 15 meditations; the trophy needs all 18.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's strand is Jason-only; follow Bret's quests until the hunt is offered, then take down the unique animal. Bret's quests are also required for 100% completion, so this strand does double duty.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. There are 18 sets in the game; cards are found across Leonida. The 100% checklist needs all 15 of Bret's target decks, so card hunting overlaps with the checklist — collect as you explore and the trophy comes with it.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations: open the WAiNK app and scan landmarks, curiosities and sculptures. The app marks what you have scanned, so sweep each area as you explore it — scanning also counts vehicle discoveries for Whip It Good, so one habit feeds two trophies.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. There are 80 challenges in 8 groups of 10, and the 100% checklist needs 70 — so this trophy pops on the way to A Long Road. You have 10 challenges to spare for 100%, so skip the hardest ones and do the ones that overlap with your other goals.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat: get the cops to 4 stars while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the wanted level clears. Open ground with plenty of alleys and rooftops makes the escape easier than a highway chase.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Chain three shop robberies inside a single wanted level — plan a route through three close shops and keep moving. Getting caught, or the wanted level clearing, resets the chain, so do it in one clean run.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. A WAiNK scan is enough to count a discovery, so scan every unfamiliar vehicle — including boats and aircraft — as you travel. The 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base models, so the scanning habit pays off twice.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Wait for a fight with a group of enemies, trigger Combat Focus and drop 5 of them before it ends — a packed shootout is the place, not a one-on-one.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA (Vice City International Airport). The description is a wink — leave the airport in a way the schedule did not plan. No published guide has pinned the exact trigger yet, so treat this as an odd-job trophy to try at the airport and watch PowerPyx's guide for the confirmed method.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos — the description points at Rhino tanks. Expect a wanted-level rampage or a military encounter involving Rhinos. No published guide has pinned the exact trigger yet, so check PowerPyx's guide as players crack it rather than grinding blind.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet — no alarms, no witnesses spotting you — and get out clean. Stealth matters more than speed here; if the alarm trips, leave and try again.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Bank vault robberies are required for 100% completion too, so they are not optional — plan each one, hit the vault, and escape cleanly afterwards. Five vaults, five clean getaways.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Hit a truck on the road, grab the cash and lose the heat — armored trucks patrol the highways, so pick a quiet stretch and be ready to run.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. PSN tracks 52 areas; the map fills in as you travel, so the trophy comes from thorough exploration — and the WAiNK scans and vehicle discoveries overlap with it, so explore with the scanner out.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. There are 9 gangs; hit one illegal operation per gang. Operations are found by exploring gang territory — clear one per gang and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and take in the view — the description itself is the whole hint. This is one of the five trophies no published guide has fully pinned down yet, so if the obvious spot does not pop it, watch the published guides for the confirmed trigger.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. One of the five trophies no published guide has fully pinned down yet — the description is the whole hint: find a vehicle showroom and leave through the glass in style, the way the old games taught you.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Go bowling at the Kolt & Associates alley and finish a game — bowling is a proper activity in the game, and this is its trophy.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. One of the five trophies no published guide has fully pinned down yet — the description hints at a co-op moment with your partner that lands with the public. Watch the published guides for the confirmed trigger rather than guessing.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). PSN tracks a count to 500: perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. Just play — choices and criminal actions accumulate across the whole run, and the count climbs on its own over 200 hours.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. One of the five trophies no published guide has fully pinned down yet — the description suggests succeeding on a second attempt at something that first went wrong. Watch the published guides for the confirmed trigger.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? One of the five trophies no published guide has fully pinned down yet — the description points at a strange, probably scripted event somewhere in Leonida. Keep exploring the odd corners of the map and watch the published guides for the confirmed trigger.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. One of the five trophies no published guide has fully pinned down yet — the description suggests knocking people down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. The bowling reference is a joke, not a location: this is about drive-by melee, not the bowling alley.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies; launder them through your contacts until $250,000 is clean. It overlaps with the robbery trophies, so it builds up naturally as you work Maximum Withdrawal and the other heists.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy clothes, food, weapons and anything else — all shop spending counts, so it pops naturally on a long playthrough. If you are close at the end, top it up with ammunition and clothes.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Buy them all — they also store the vehicles you register for On the Spot, so garages and vehicle collecting go together. Save up and buy them as you can afford them.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles, then register them in the Scooter Bros app — your garages from Little Boxes give you somewhere to keep them, and the WAiNK scanning from Whip It Good teaches you the habit.
trophies.name: On the Spot
